visual_observations: The output is one recognizable folding A-frame promo sign with two hinged panels, a visible hinge, feet and a complete object silhouette.
The front graphic is colorful food illustration without legible text, letters, numerals or logos.
Warm hand-painted shading and restrained texture broadly match the requested tycoon-game look.
The sprite shows a plausible elevated three-quarter view, but the ground-plane axes are not demonstrably calibrated to the exact 2:1 iso2x_v1 projection; projection QA is therefore not passed.
A faint alpha fringe reaches the top canvas edge; do not crop or stretch this original to hide it.
